sources.provider: Two Tulips Boutique, Purdue Sorority custom House Drawing (artist Courtney Day)
sources.feature_id: Sigma Kappa house illustration labeled 427 N Russell Street
sources.method: Visual comparison only. The image is a signed artist illustration, not a photograph or scale drawing.
sources.observation: Shows a broad two-story red-brick house with symmetrical end gables, a centered white columned portico and pediment, dormer windows, and a chimney.
sources.uncertainty: Illustration is stylized, unscaled, and not georeferenced; facade orientation and dimensions are not measured.

sources.method: Chapter house history and occupancy scale context only.
sources.observation: Says Sigma Kappa moved into its 427 Russell Street chapter house in 1952 and housed about 80–82 members in 2016.
sources.uncertainty: No structural or measured architecture details.

modeling_observations.footprint: The asset base uses the official 21-vertex FID 780 ring in campus coordinates.
modeling_observations.main_levels: Two visible exterior levels inferred from the artist illustration; source GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 is undocumented.
modeling_observations.roof: Twin front gables and a lower central roof with four dormers inferred from the illustration.
modeling_observations.frontage: West-facing frontage toward Russell Street is illustrative; the art image has no geolocation.
modeling_observations.height: Eaves, ridges, chimney, floor count, and all vertical dimensions are estimates; GIS Extrution=12 is undefined.
